Postgres to ClickHouse: Data Modeling Tips V2
Lionel Palacin & Sai Srirampur
Mar 6, 2025
-
26
minutes read
It is becoming increasingly
common
for customers to use Postgres and ClickHouse together, with Postgres powering transactional workloads and ClickHouse powering analytics. Each is a purpose-built database optimized for its respective workload. A common approach to integrating Postgres with ClickHouse is Change Data Capture (CDC). CDC continuously tracks inserts, updates, and deletes in Postgres and replicates them to ClickHouse, enabling real-time analytics.
You can implement Postgres CDC to ClickHouse using
PeerDB
, an open-source replication tool, or leverage a fully integrated experience in ClickHouse Cloud with
ClickPipes
.
Since Postgres and ClickHouse are different databases, an important aspect alongside replication is effectively modeling tables and queries in ClickHouse to maximize performance.
This blog takes a deep dive into how Postgres CDC to ClickHouse works internally and delves into best practices for data modeling and query tuning.
We will cover topics such as data deduplication strategies, handling custom ordering keys, optimizing JOINs, materialized views (MVs) including refreshable MVs, denormalization, and more.
You can also apply these learnings to one-time migrations (not CDC) from Postgres, so we expect this to help any Postgres users looking to use ClickHouse for analytics. We published a
v1
of this blog late last year; this one will be an advanced version of that blog.
Dataset
#
Throughout this blog post, we will illustrate the strategies using a real-world dataset, specifically a subset of the well-known StackOverflow dataset, which we will load into PostgreSQL. This dataset is used across ClickHouse documentation, and you can find more information about it
here
. We also implemented a Python script that simulates user activity on StackOverflow. Instructions on how to reproduce the experiments can be found on
GitHub
.
How does data get replicated?
#
PostgreSQL logical decoding
#
ClickPipes and PeerDB use
Postgres Logical Decoding
to consume changes as they happen in Postgres. The Logical Decoding process in Postgres enables clients like ClickPipes to receive changes in a human-readable format, i.e., a series of INSERTs, UPDATEs, and DELETEs. To learn more about how Logical Decoding works, you can read one of our
blogs
that goes into full detail.
As part of the replication process, ClickPipes automatically creates corresponding tables with the most
native data-type mapping
in ClickHouse and performs initial snapshots/backfills super
efficiently
.
ReplacingMergeTree
#
ClickPipes maps Postgres tables to ClickHouse using the
ReplacingMergeTree
engine. ClickHouse performs best with append-only workloads and
does not recommend
frequent UPDATEs. This is where ReplacingMergeTree is particularly powerful.
With ReplacingMergeTree, updates are modeled as inserts with a newer version (
_peerdb_version
) of the row, while deletes are inserts with a newer version and
_peerdb_is_deleted
marked as true. The ReplacingMergeTree engine in background deduplicates/merges data and retains the latest version of the row for a given primary key (id), enabling efficient handling of UPDATEs and DELETEs as versioned inserts.

Illustrative example
#
The illustration below walks through a basic example of synchronization of a table
users
between PostgreSQL and ClickHouse using ClickPipes.
Step 1
shows the initial snapshot of the 2 rows in PostgreSQL and ClickPipes performing the initial load of those 2 rows to ClickHouse. If you observe, both rows are copied as-is to ClickHouse.
Step 2
shows three operations on the users table: inserting a new row, updating an existing row, and deleting another row.
Step 3
shows how ClickPipes replicates the INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations to ClickHouse as versioned inserts. The UPDATE appears as a new version of the row with ID 2, while the DELETE appears as a new version of ID 1 with is _deleted marked as true. Because of this, ClickHouse has three additional rows compared to PostgreSQL.

data.title: AMD's new 96-core Threadripper CPU
data.author: liquid99
data.article_summary: AMD即将于7月23日发售基于Zen 5架构的Ryzen Threadripper Pro 9000 WX系列CPU，最高端的Threadripper Pro 9995WX拥有96核192线程，售价高达11,699美元。该系列还包括其他型号：64核的9985WX售价7,999美元，32核的9975WX售价4,099美元，24核的9965WX售价2,899美元，以及24核的9955WX起售价1,649美元。这些处理器专为工作站设计，适用于专业渲染和本地AI部署，性能较前代有显著提升。Dell、HP、Lenovo和Supermicro等厂商也将推出搭载该系列芯片的高端工作站。非Pro版的Threadripper 9980X和9970X价格尚未公布，预计会更低。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AMD Pro 9000 WX-Series处理器的性能、价格以及市场竞争

不同观点：
• **[amelius]** 关注AMD声称的性能优势，质疑是否在使用CPU模拟GPU的功能。具体提到在运行基于上下文的提示推理测试（DeepSeek R1 32B）时，Threadripper Pro 9000比Intel快49%。该评论者对AMD如何实现这种性能提升表示怀疑，认为可能是在用CPU做GPU的工作。

• **[highfrequency]** 对Pro 9000系列的定价表示失望，指出其价格不低于现有的AMD服务器处理器Epyc Turin 9655（96核，11.5千美元）。同时提到，Pro 9000系列的每核心价格显著低于早期的Threadripper 64核 3990x（3900美元），认为性价比不佳。

• **[oblio]** 关注旧型号处理器的市场供应情况，询问是否旧版本已经不再生产或供应有限。此外，对Intel是否拥有类似产品表示好奇，提出市场竞争的问题。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了AMD Pro 9000 WX-Series处理器的性能数据和竞争对手Intel的对比，尤其是性能和价格的比较。
• 对价格和性价比的讨论揭示了消费者对新处理器系列的期望与实际市场定价之间的差距。
• 市场供应和竞争产品的讨论引发了对旧型号处理器是否仍然可用以及Intel是否有类似产品的疑问。

争议焦点：
• AMD Pro 9000 WX-Series处理器在性能测试中的表现是否依赖于CPU执行GPU任务的能力，这一点引发了对实际应用场景和性能优势的质疑。
• 新处理器的定价策略是否合理，尤其是在与旧型号和竞争对手产品对比时，消费者对性价比的关注。

AMD’s new 96-core Threadripper CPU will set you back $11,699
The Threadripper Pro 9000 WX-Series starts at $1,649 and ships on July 23rd.
The Threadripper Pro 9000 WX-Series starts at $1,649 and ships on July 23rd.
by
Tom Warren
Jul 17, 2025, 3:10 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
Image: AMD
Tom Warren
is a senior editor and author of
Notepad
, who has been covering all things Microsoft, PC, and tech for over 20 years.
AMD’s latest Zen 5-based Ryzen
Threadripper Pro 9000 WX-Series
of CPUs go on sale later this month, and the top option will be
priced at $11,699
. The 9000 WX-Series chips are designed for workstations, with the $11,699 Threadripper Pro 9995WX shipping on July 23rd with 96 cores and 192 threads.
Dell, HP, Lenovo, and Supermicro will all start selling high-end workstations with the latest Threadripper 9000 series of chips on July 23rd, and DIY builders will be able to purchase the processors through AMD’s channel partners.
AMD’s Threadripper Pro 9995WX looks like it will comfortably beat its previous generation chips.
Image: AMD
AMD will also offer the 64-core Threadripper Pro 9985WX for $7,999, the 32-core Threadripper Pro 9975WX for $4,099, the 24-core Threadripper Pro 9965WX for $2,899, and the Threadripper Pro 9955WX for $1,649. All five processors are designed to be faster in professional rendering tools like Chaos V-Ray, or tools like Adobe After Effects.
The Pro 9000 WX-Series processors are also designed for local AI deployments, including fine-tuning models, inference, and AI application development. “When running a context-based prompting inference test using DeepSeek R1 32B, we are seeing a 49 percent better performance of Threadripper Pro 9000 over Intel,” claims AMD.
AMD hasn’t yet revealed pricing for its non-Pro
Threadripper 9980X and 9970X processors
, but expect those prices to be a lot less for DIY builders.

data.title: MIPS: The hyperactive history and legacy of the pioneering RISC architecture
data.author: rob_lh
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MIPS架构的历史、技术特点、衰落原因及其与竞争架构的比较

不同观点：
• **MIPS的成功与失败**：brucehoult认为MIPS在游戏机、网络设备和超级计算机等多个领域取得了显著成功，但最终由于SGI转向Itanium而放弃MIPS，导致其衰落。这表明MIPS的技术实力和市场潜力，但管理决策失误是其失败的主要原因。

• **MIPS架构的优点与缺点**：brucehoult指出MIPS架构设计经典且具有持久的价值，但也存在一些技术上的不足，例如延迟槽和条件分支需要多条指令，这相对于一些现代ISA（如ARM）显得不够高效。

• **MIPS与ARM的竞争**：brucehoult提到MIPS在引入混合指令集（如MIPS16和microMIPS）方面落后于ARM，总是处于跟随地位，缺乏领导力，这可能是其在与ARM竞争中失利的原因之一。

• **MIPS的未来与RISC-V的兴起**：brucehoult认为，设计和维护一个独立的ISA非常昂贵且困难，MIPS虽然推出了nanoMIPS，但为时已晚，无法与已经获得关注的RISC-V竞争。他希望MIPS的工程师能在RISC-V上取得成功。

补充讨论：
• **技术幽默与竞争**：DonHopkins分享了一个关于硬件设计师间的玩笑，提到MIPS可以支持大小端（SPIM），而SPARC的小端版本被戏称为CRAPS，这反映出当时技术人员之间的竞争和幽默文化。

争议焦点：
• **MIPS的衰落是由于技术原因还是管理决策**：brucehoult明确指出MIPS的衰落主要是因为SGI在Itanium上的错误决策，而不仅仅是因为技术上的不足。这暗示了管理决策在技术产品成败中的关键作用。

• **MIPS的衰落是由于技术原因还是管理决策**：brucehoult明确指出MIPS的衰落主要是因为SGI在Itanium上的错误决策，而不仅仅是因为技术上的不足。这暗示了管理决策在技术产品成败中的关键作用。

data.title: The borrowchecker is what I like the least about Rust
data.author: jakobnissen
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了Rust语言中的借用检查器（borrow checker），这是Rust实现内存安全的核心机制，但也带来了不少人体工学问题。作者认为借用检查器被过度推崇，其在Rust安全性中的作用被夸大。借用检查器要求在编译时确定所有引用的生命周期，这一要求过于严格，导致许多合理的代码被拒绝。例如，当代码中同时存在多个指向不同字段的可变引用时，借用检查器会错误地拒绝这些代码。此外，借用检查器无法跨函数或在函数内的控制流之间进行有效推理，导致更多误报。作者指出，借用检查器的这些局限性给开发者带来了实际的困扰，尤其是在修改现有项目时。尽管小例子可以展示问题，但真正的痛苦往往在处理大型项目时才会显现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust语言的borrow checker（借用检查器）的优缺点及其对语言成功的影响

不同观点：
• eigenspace认为，borrow checker是Rust成功的重要原因。他指出，新语言很难成功，除非能展示出其他语言无法实现的功能。borrow checker提供了这种独特性，并吸引了特定的开发者文化。
• alilleybrinker解释了borrow checker在跨函数推理 borrowing（借用）方面的局限性，并提出了一些绕过这些限制的方法，如使用getter函数或直接访问公共字段。
• jltsiren分享了自己在Rust和C++之间的开发经验，指出在Rust中需要以Rust的方式编写代码，而不是将C++的思维方式带入Rust。他还提到使用索引在图/树实现中的好处。
• IshKebab强调borrow checker不仅限于内存安全，还能提高代码的正确性，因为它强制了一种树状所有权模式。
• Fraterkes指出，borrow checker的严格性在某些开发场景（如生态系统建设）中是有益的，但在其他场景（如游戏开发）中可能不合适，因为这些场景需要更大的灵活性。
• int_19h探讨了从Rust中提取一个不使用borrow checker的子集的可能性，并提出了使用宏和自定义标准库的方案。
• airstrike表示，虽然不喜欢borrow checker，但其他特性（如模式匹配、零成本抽象、类型系统、并发安全性等）使Rust仍然具有吸引力。
• umanwizard支持Rust的借用规则，认为它们对于确保代码正确性是必要的，并指出这些规则不仅仅是实现细节，而是Rust语言设计的核心部分。
• Animats指出Rust中的borrow checker在处理后向引用时的不足，并讨论了三种常见的工作around（使用索引、不安全代码、运行时检查），同时提出静态分析工具的可能解决方案。
• int08h对比了Rust和C++，认为C++中的元编程问题比Rust的借用检查问题更复杂和烦人。
• cibyr和isodev认为，borrow checker是Rust提供无垃圾收集语言中最好的解决方案，并且编译器帮助开发者识别潜在问题是Rust的一大优势。
• mirekrusin和dhbradshaw提到MoonBit和Gleam作为Rust的替代语言，它们没有borrow checker但具有类似的特性。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到Rust的borrow checker在某些场景下的局限性，如后向引用问题和跨函数推理问题。
• 一些开发者提出了绕过borrow checker限制的方法，如使用索引、不安全代码或运行时检查。
• 也有开发者支持borrow checker，认为它是Rust语言成功和代码正确性的关键因素。
• 探讨了Rust中可能的语言设计改进和工具支持，如静态分析和Polonius借用检查算法。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于borrow checker的严格性是否必要，以及它对开发效率和代码正确性的影响。一些开发者认为borrow checker过于严格，限制了开发的灵活性，而另一些开发者则认为它是Rust成功的核心，并确保了代码的正确性和安全性。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对某个动态链接库（dll）及其潜在安全风险的分析与讨论

不同观点：
• [acheong08] 关注该dll文件是否存在逆向工程的可能性，特别是其是否会泄露敏感信息（如SSH密钥）。他认为仅仅回滚软件版本可能不足以解决问题，如果该dll文件已经外泄了重要数据，如Git的SSH密钥，将会造成更大的安全风险。

• [c-hendricks] 将讨论引向具体的技术组件，指出问题可能与`eslint-config-prettier`和`eslint-plugin-prettier`有关，而不是`prettier`本身。这个观点将讨论聚焦于可能存在漏洞的具体软件包上。

• [gausswho] 提出该漏洞是否仅限于Windows操作系统的问题，表明他关注该安全问题的影响范围，是否会波及其他平台。

• [tiagod] 对事件的严重性做出简短评价，认为情况非常糟糕，但没有具体展开技术细节。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：目前的主要争议在于该dll文件的具体作用和潜在危害，特别是它是否会泄露敏感数据（如SSH密钥）。此外，还有人关心该漏洞的影响范围，特别是是否仅限于Windows系统。

• 重要论据：acheong08提出了关于SSH密钥泄露的潜在风险，c-hendricks则明确了可能出问题的具体软件包，这为后续分析和修复提供了方向。

• 未展开的技术细节：tiagod认为情况很糟糕，但没有详细说明原因，这可能意味着大家对该漏洞的完整影响尚不完全了解，有待进一步分析。

data.title: Triggering QUIC
data.author: gm678
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了触发客户端使用QUIC传输协议的机制。传统方法是让应用尝试通过QUIC连接，若失败则回退到TCP。然而，这种方法可能导致延迟，特别是在网络不支持QUIC的情况下。为避免时间 penalty，服务器可在首次TCP/TLS连接中通过HTTP头字段（如`alt-svc`）向客户端表明其支持QUIC，使客户端在后续连接中使用QUIC。这种方法已在Chrome浏览器中使用多年。

此外，Apple的Safari浏览器通过DNS查询（使用SVCB记录和ALPN字段）直接确定服务器是否支持QUIC，从而触发QUIC连接。这意味着目前存在两种主要的QUIC触发机制：Chrome使用的“第二使用”方法和Safari依赖的DNS方法。

最后，文章提到衡量QUIC采用率的传统方法，即通过支持QUIC的服务统计其使用率。

主要讨论点：HTTP协议的演变及其复杂性

不同观点：
• BobbyTables2认为，尽管赞赏作者的努力，但在修复其他问题时加入错误的转折是不合理的。他指出，原始的HTTP协议简单而优雅，页面主要是结构简单的HTML。他认为，如今的HTTP协议变得过于复杂，超出了原先的想象。

补充讨论：
• 有人可能认为HTTP协议的复杂化是技术发展的必然结果，因为现代网络应用需要处理更多样化和复杂的需求，例如安全性、实时交互和大数据传输等。
• BobbyTables2的观点中隐含了对技术简约性的怀旧，认为简单性是原先设计的一个优点，而现代变化可能牺牲了这种优点。
• 争议的焦点在于，技术进步是否必然导致复杂性增加，以及这种复杂性是否合理和必要。

44616754.article_content:
The ISP Column
A column on various things Internet
Other Formats:
Triggering QUIC
July 2025
Geoff Huston
Last month, in June 2025, I
reported
on our progress with the adoption of the QUIC transport protocol. Here I would like to look at the mechanisms used to trigger a client application (typically a browser) to connect to the server using the QUIC transport protocol.
A conventional way to introduce a new transport service is to let applications initiate a connection using the new service. If the connection is unresponsive, then the application can back off to use the old transport service. In the case of QUIC, this would be a QUIC connection request made via a UDP packet directed to the serverâs port 443, and if the client doesnât receive a response after some timeout interval it will fall back to TCP (and TLS) by sending a SYN packet to the serverâs TCP destination port 443.
This connection process can be slow, particularly if the server or the intervening network does not support QUIC transport. As the client isnât necessarily aware of the round-trip time to the server, the client would normally err on the side of caution and wait at this juncture for at least one or two seconds before abandoning the connection attempt. QUIC was designed to increase the responsiveness of services over the network, not to introduce new sources of delay. A client could could use a smaller timeout interval, but this would be prone to false signals, where the client falls back to TCP unnecessarily. A client could set up a âconnection raceâ, sending a QUIC connection packet and a TCP SYN packet, and follow through by completing the connection with the first protocol to respond, but this would impose additional load on the server as it is forced to set up two connection contexts for every client connection.
One way to establish if a QUIC connection is viable  without paying a time penalty is for the server to signal the capability to use QUIC to the client in the first (TCP/TLS) connection, allowing the client to initiate a QUIC session on the second and subsequent connections. This second-use approach is defined in an Internet standard for Alternative Services (
RFC 7838
), which is a means to list alternative ways to access the same resources, using the HTTP header fields.
For example,
alt-svc: quic=":443"; ma=2592000;
This indicates that the same material is accessible using QUIC over port 443. The âmaâ field is the time to keep this information cached in the local client (in seconds), which in this case is 30 days. The semantics of this header is that this is not an unconditional directive, and the client is free to ignore this information and continue with the existing TCP/TLS protocol choice.
However, itâs not quite as simple as it may sound. The HTTP protocol introduced the concept of session persistence in HTTP/1.0 so that the underlying transport session is kept open for some keepalive interval, allowing reuse of the TCP and TLS state without the overheads of establishing a new session. The implication for the second-use signaling approach was that the original HTTP session was kept open across multiple requests, indefinitely deferring any subsequent connection that would use the QUIC transport protocol.
This form of triggering the use of QUIC has been bundled into the Chrome browser for more than a decade.
When Apple introduced support for QUIC in its Safari browser they used a different trigger, namely the DNS. The IETF has introduced the SVCB record in the DNS, allowing a number of connection profile items to be stashed in the DNS (RFC 9460). SVCB records facilitate the discovery of alternative endpoints for a service, allowing clients to choose the most suitable endpoint based on their needs and capabilities. There is the HTTPS DNS record, which is the SVCB record for use for HTTPS service connections. Relevant here is the
Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation
(ALPN) field where the token h3 denotes a server capability to support QUIC (HTTP/3) (
RFC 9114
).
Safari browsers that support the use of QUIC will query the DNS for an HTTPS record, and if there is an alpn field that specifies h3 in this record, then the browser can immediately proceed with opening a QUIC connection to the server, based on the knowledge that the server has indicated that it can support QUIC connections.
This form of triggering the use of QUIC has been bundled into the Safari browser for more than a year.
This means that we have two triggers for the use of QUIC, one as a âsecond useâ in-band alternative service directive imbedded in the HTTPS protocol exchange, which appears to be predominately used by the Chrome browser, and the DNS HTTPS trigger, which appears to be predominately used by the Safari browser.
Measuring QUIC

Flux - High-Performance Message Transport
Flux is a high-performance message transport library (IPC, UDP, Reliable UDP) for Rust, implementing LMAX Disruptor patterns with zero-copy memory management and lock-free operations.

data.title: How AI Vibe Coding Is Destroying Junior Developers' Careers
data.author: namanyayg
data.article_summary:
2025年，科技行业面临严重危机，已有超过94,000名科技工作者被解雇。尤其是初级开发人员，面临巨大挑战。据《印度时报》报道，美国软件开发岗位减少了70%以上，新毕业生很难进入科技行业。在严峻的就业市场中，许多新开发人员转向“氛围编码”（vibe coding），即利用AI构建应用而无需学习编码。这种方法造就了一批缺乏基本技能的“伪开发人员”，他们无法在竞争激烈的行业中生存。

“氛围编码”依赖AI生成代码，开发人员不写代码也不调试，直到“感觉对了”为止。这种方法跳过了学习过程，导致开发人员在遇到问题时只会依赖AI，形成恶性循环。研究显示，使用AI工具的开发人员生产力实际下降了19%，但他们自己却认为提高了20%。这种认知与现实的巨大差距表明，AI对成熟复杂项目的开发可能适得其反。

一个独立开发人员通过氛围编码创建SaaS产品，最终因无法调试和维护代码，项目失败。专家警告，随着更多公司使用AI生成代码，类似问题将频繁出现。

44618243.article_content:
The tech industry is facing a massive crisis in 2025.
Over 94,000 tech workers have already been laid off across 150 companies
this year alone. For junior developers, the situation is especially challenging. According to a
Times of India report
, software developer job openings in the U.S. have shrunk by over 70%, making it increasingly difficult for new graduates to break into tech.
In this tough job market, many new developers are turning to "
vibe coding."
This is a shortcut that promises to build applications using AI without actually learning to code. But this solution is making the problem worse. It's creating a generation of
pseudo-developers
who lack the basic skills needed to survive in an increasingly competitive industry.
The Vibe Coding Trap: A False Promise
Vibe coding describes a philosophy where developers "
fully give into the vibes, embrace exponentials, and forget that the code even exists.
" Originally created by Andrej Karpathy for throwaway weekend projects, the term has been hijacked by those promoting it as a real development approach.
In practice, vibe coding means using AI models to build your entire application without writing a single line of code yourself. When something breaks, you don't debug. You just keep asking the AI until it "feels right." As one developer explains: "
It's coding without coding.
You use AI models to build your entire app.
You don't write a single line yourself, not even for debugging.
"
This creates what we might call "the new tutorial hell." Unlike traditional learning where you at least absorbed concepts while watching tutorials, vibe coding skips the learning process entirely. You hit a problem, throw it at an AI, get a working solution, ship it quickly, then repeat the same cycle tomorrow when you face a similar issue.
The appeal is obvious, especially for newcomers facing a brutal job market. Why spend years learning complex programming languages when you can just describe what you want in plain English? The promise sounds amazing: no technical knowledge required, just explain your vision and watch the AI build it.
The illusion of Productivity: What the Data Actually Says?
Recent research
reveals a shocking disconnect between perception and reality when it comes to AI coding productivity. A rigorous METR study conducted in 2025 tracked
16 experienced developers
from major open-source projects as they completed 246 real-world coding tasks. The results were startling: developers using AI tools experienced a 19% decrease in productivity compared to working without AI assistance.
Even more concerning, the developers themselves were completely unaware of this slowdown.
They estimated that AI had increased their productivity by 20%
,
while the actual data showed the opposite
. This represents a massive 39-point gap between perception and reality, suggesting that many glowing reports about AI productivity gains may be fundamentally flawed.
The study was conducted as a randomized controlled trial under real-world conditions, with tasks randomly assigned to "
AI Allowed
" or
"AI Disallowed
" categories. Developers spent substantial time reviewing AI-generated code, with only 39% of AI code generations being accepted. Much of the supposed time savings from AI was offset by the need to prompt, wait for responses, review output, and often discard flawed code entirely.
This research challenges the widespread belief that AI tools are universally boosting developer productivity.
While AI may help with certain types of tasks, the study suggests that for experienced developers working on mature, complex codebases, these tools may actually be counterproductive. The gap between what developers think is happening and what's actually happening raises serious questions about how we're measuring and understanding AI's impact on software development.
When Vibe Coding Fails: The Catastrophic Failures
The most documented failure involves an indie developer who built a SaaS product entirely through vibe coding. Initially celebrating on social media that his "saas was built with Cursor, zero hand written code," the story quickly turned dark.
Source
Within weeks, disaster struck. The developer reported that "random things are happening, maxed out usage on api keys, people bypassing the subscription, creating random shit on db." Being non-technical, he couldn't debug the security breaches or understand what was going wrong. The application was eventually shut down permanently after he admitted "Cursor keeps breaking other parts of the code."
This failure illustrates the core problem with vibe coding:
it produces developers who can generate code but can't understand, debug, or maintain it. When AI-generated code breaks, these developers are helpless.
Industry experts predicted this exact scenario. As one observer noted in early 2025, companies would soon "learn what happens when their codebases are infiltrated with AI generated code at scale." We're now seeing bigger incidents with

2025年，科技行业面临严重危机，已有超过94,000名科技工作者被解雇。尤其是初级开发人员，面临巨大挑战。据《印度时报》报道，美国软件开发岗位减少了70%以上，新毕业生很难进入科技行业。在严峻的就业市场中，许多新开发人员转向“氛围编码”（vibe coding），即利用AI构建应用而无需学习编码。这种方法造就了一批缺乏基本技能的“伪开发人员”，他们无法在竞争激烈的行业中生存。

“氛围编码”依赖AI生成代码，开发人员不写代码也不调试，直到“感觉对了”为止。这种方法跳过了学习过程，导致开发人员在遇到问题时只会依赖AI，形成恶性循环。研究显示，使用AI工具的开发人员生产力实际下降了19%，但他们自己却认为提高了20%。这种认知与现实的巨大差距表明，AI对成熟复杂项目的开发可能适得其反。

一个独立开发人员通过氛围编码创建SaaS产品，最终因无法调试和维护代码，项目失败。专家警告，随着更多公司使用AI生成代码，类似问题将频繁出现。

data.title: EPA shutters its scientific research arm
data.author: MPSFounder
data.article_summary: 美国环保署（EPA）宣布关闭其科学部门——研究与开发办公室（ORD），以节省7.488亿美元。该部门拥有超过1500名员工，负责关键的环境污染研究。此次关闭是机构重组的一部分，EPA员工总数已从2025年1月的16,155人减少到12,488人，减幅达22%。多数ORD员工通过新闻得知此消息，尚未收到正式通知。一些员工将被调任，其余可能离职。由于科学岗位减少，一些员工考虑赴海外工作。前EPA官员批评此举危及公共健康和环境监督，可能导致更严重的污染和经济负担。ORD研究涵盖多个领域，如“永久化学品”PFAS、水传播疾病和儿童哮喘的环境因素等。

44617718.article_content:
Lead-up to Congress' funding cuts
What led to Congress passing foreign aid, public broadcasting cuts
03:07
The Environmental Protection Agency announced Friday afternoon that
it is eliminating
its scientific division, known as the Office of Research and Development.
The move to shutter the ORD comes one day after the agency said it was undergoing a reorganization involving several other EPA divisions.
ORD conducts critical research to "safeguard human health and ecosystems from environmental pollutants,"
according to its website
. More than 1,500 employees, including scientists and researchers, are dispersed across the country at
11 different locations
, but the bulk are based at the EPA's headquarters in Washington, D.C., and at a large scientific facility in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina.
Eliminating the office will bring $748.8 million in savings, according to a news release from the agency.
The EPA had 16,155 employees back in January 2025, but following voluntary retirements, dismissals, and other reduction in force (RIF) actions, it is now down to 12,488 employees, the agency said in its release Friday, a reduction of about 22% of its staff. The staffing cuts include 3,201 employees who took the Trump administration's so-called "
Fork in the Road
" deferred resignation program, as well as those who took early retirement.
"Under President Trump's leadership, EPA has taken a close look at our operations to ensure the agency is better equipped than ever to deliver on our core mission of protecting human health and the environment while Powering the Great American Comeback," EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said in a statement Friday. "This reduction in force will ensure we can better fulfill that mission while being responsible stewards of your hard-earned tax dollars."
It was anticipated that ORD would be impacted,
according to earlier documents that outlined the agency's RIF plans
. Back in March, the documents indicated that somewhere between 50% to 75% of ORD employees would not be retained, the majority of them leading scientists in their field of research.
A source inside ORD told CBS News Friday that employees found out about the reduction in force via the press release that was sent out to the public, and has not received any formal communication from the agency about what will happen next.
"A friend texted me the press release," the source told CBS News, "that is how I found out."
According to the source, most employees are anxiously checking their email, waiting to see if they'll be reassigned to another program office, or impacted by the reduction.
Some ORD employees have already received notification that they have been reassigned, while most wait to learn their fate. In May, ORD employees were told they would be contacted by other programs inside the agency to discuss potential, lateral moves. But according to the source, it now appears that impacted individuals won't get much of a choice: either take the reassignment if one is offered, or leave the agency.
"I don't think I can stay in the U.S.," one source told CBS News, "there are no jobs here."
Because of cuts to the federal workforce and cuts to scientific research, there are very few scientific positions available in the U.S., and some are now contemplating work abroad.
"Today's cuts dismantle one of the world's most respected environmental health research organizations," said Jennifer Orme-Zavaleta, former EPA principal deputy assistant administrator for science, in a statement. "EPA's science office has long been recognized internationally for advancing public health protections through rigorous science. Reducing its workforce under the guise of cost savings is both misleading and dangerous. This does
not
save taxpayers money; it simply shifts costs to hospitals, families and communities left to bear the health and economic consequences of increased pollution and weakened oversight. The people of this country are not well served by these actions. They are left more vulnerable."
The ORD's research touches on a range of issues from PFAS, often referred to as "forever chemicals," to water-bourne diseases, soot in the air, and environmental factors that contribute to childhood asthma, Orme-Zavaleta said.
It is made up of six major research program offices, per its website, that include
Air, Climate, and Energy
,
Chemical Safety for Sustainability
,
Health and Environmental Risk Assessment
,
Homeland Security
,
Safe and Sustainable Water Resources
and
Sustainable and Healthy Communities
.
It also includes four major research labs including the
Center for Computational Toxicology and Exposure (CCTE)
, the
Center for Environmental Measurement and Modeling (CEMM)
, the
Center for Environmental Solutions and Emergency Response (CESER)
and the
Center for Public Health and Environmental Assessment (CPHEA)
.

data.title: lsr: ls with io_uring
data.author: mpweiher
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了作者实现的一个比传统 `ls` 更快的文件列表工具 `lsr`，它使用了作者的 IO 库 `ourio`，通过 io_uring 进行大量 IO 操作，从而大幅减少系统调用次数。根据基准测试，`lsr` 比其他类似工具（如 `ls`, `eza`, `lsd` 等）速度更快，系统调用次数少一个数量级。`lsr` 通过批量处理 `stat` 调用和减少动态内存分配来优化性能，且由于静态链接，减少了 libc 相关的开销。文章还提到排序是主要工作负载之一，并表示使用 io_uring 显著优化了系统调用。项目使用了 `tangled.sh` 进行开发，并鼓励贡献代码和反馈。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕使用 io_uring 优化的 `ls` 命令替代方案的性能、实用性及技术细节的讨论。

不同观点：
• 作者 [rockorager] 介绍了项目的技术实现，并提供了进一步的技术文档链接，侧重于 io_uring 的应用及其性能提升。
• [ninkendo] 关注项目在不可靠网络环境下（如NFS服务器）的表现，质疑 io_uring 是否能缓解 NFS 设计中的固有缺陷，特别是在处理中断连接时的表现。
• [SillyUsername] 支持 io_uring 的广泛应用，通过实际例子（如 nvme 硬盘速度提升）说明其优势，并希望更多命令行工具采用 io_uring。
• [Imustaskforhelp] 对项目的功能表示赞赏，但提到与现有工具 `eza` 相比，`lsr` 在文件类型识别和颜色显示方面有所不足，同时提出对更多工具（如 `cat`）的需求。
• [maplant] 认为 io_uring 带来的性能提升在实际使用中（如列出10,000个文件）并不明显，因此对切换工具的必要性提出质疑，更关注其教学和演示价值。
• [swiftcoder] 对 io_uring 减少系统调用次数但仅带来2倍速度提升表示疑惑，质疑性能提升的实际效果。
• [michaelcampbell] 对项目的实用性持怀疑态度，认为 `ls` 的速度从未成为其使用中的问题，但对项目作为学习和趣味应用表示认可。

补充讨论：
• [the8472] 指出 io_uring 不支持 `getdents`，因此其主要优势在于批量 `stat` 操作，并提出如果能同时处理多个 `getdents` 请求会更有益。
• [jasonjmcghee] 对项目中图标支持的文件类型选择提出质疑，指出某些常见文件类型（如 `.c`, `.h`）没有图标。
• [adgjlsfhk1] 对 uutils 项目的性能表现感到失望，认为其是推动核心工具现代化的希望，但目前表现不如 GNU。
• [pvtmert] 通过 `strace` 分析 `lsd` 的行为，发现其多次调用 `clock_gettime`，猜测可能与时间计算相关。
• [tln] 提到文件系统性能的改进，指出现代文件系统在处理大量文件时的表现更好，并回忆过去在 ext2 文件系统上的经验。
• [quibono] 对 Zig 语言的内存分配机制提出疑问，关注其在实际应用中的使用方式。
• [Lockal] 提供了一个相关任务的链接，讨论 io_uring 在 uutils 项目中的应用潜力。
• [buybackoff] 提出一个与主题略微偏离的问题，询问 io_uring 在企业级服务器上的具体性能提升数值，特别是针对网络延迟的优化效果。

争议焦点：
• io_uring 是否能有效缓解 NFS 等不可靠网络服务的问题。
• 使用 io_uring 带来的性能提升是否值得在实际应用中替换传统工具。
• `lsr` 工具在文件类型识别和颜色显示方面的不足。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 对 Zig 语言内存分配机制的讨论。
• 对 uutils 项目性能表现的批评和期望。
• 对 io_uring 在企业级环境中的具体性能表现的询问。

44604050.article_content:
As an excercise in syscall golf, I wrote an implementation of
ls(1)
which uses my IO library,
ourio
to perform as much of the IO as possible. What I ended up with is something that is faster than any version or alternative to
ls
I tested, and also performs an
order of magnitude fewer syscalls
. I’m calling it
lsr
. Let’s start with the benchmarks, then we’ll see how we got there.

How we got there
Let’s start with how
lsr
works. To list directory contents, we basically have 3 stages to the program:
Parse args
Gather data
Print data
All of the IO involved happens in the second step. Wherever possible,
lsr
utilizes io_uring to pull in the data it needs. To get to that point, it means that we open the target directory with io_uring, if we need local time, user data, or group data, we open (and read) those files with io_uring. We do all
stat
calls via io_uring, and as needed we do the equivalent of an
lstat
via io_uring. In practice, this means that the number of syscalls we have should be drastically smaller than equivalent programs because we are able to batch the
stat
syscall. The results clearly show this…
lsr
has at least an order of magnitude fewer syscalls than it’s closest equivalent, being
uutils ls
.
We also use the zig stdlib StackFallbackAllocator. This let’s
lsr
allocate memory it needs up front, but fallback to a different allocator when it’s exhausted the fixed allocation. We allocate 1MB up front, which is more than enough for typical usage. This further reduces syscalls by reducing mmap usage.
As a result of working directly with io_uring, we also bypass several libc related pitfalls. Namely, we have no dynamic linking -
ls
has some considerable overhead in loading libc and related libraries…but it also has the benefit of having locale support.
lsr
does not boast such a feature. Despite being statically linked,
lsr
is still smaller than GNU
ls
: 138.7KB vs 79.3KB when built with ReleaseSmall.
Anomolies and Thoughts
I have no idea what
lsd
is doing. I haven’t read the source code, but from viewing it’s
strace
, it is calling
clock_gettime
around 5 times
per file
. Why? I don’t know. Maybe it’s doing internal timing of steps along the way?
Sorting ends up being a massive part of the workload. I suspect this is where
uutils ls
is getting slowed down, since it is doing pretty good on a syscall basis.
lsr
spends about 30% of it’s runtime sorting, the rest is the IO loop.
This ended up being a pretty fun project to write, and didn’t take too much time either. I am shocked at how much io_uring can be used to reduce syscalls…
ls
is a pretty basic example but you can only imagine how much of an effect this would have on something like a server.
Also - I’m using
tangled.sh
for this project. They have a really cool idea, and I want to see how the PR workflow is so…if you have any bugs or changes, please visit the
repo
. All you need is an atproto account + app password. I suspect more icons will be needed, feel free to make an issue for icon requests!

• [michaelcampbell] 对项目的实用性持怀疑态度，认为 `ls` 的速度从未成为其使用中的问题，但对项目作为学习和趣味应用表示认可。

补充讨论：
• [the8472] 指出 io_uring 不支持 `getdents`，因此其主要优势在于批量 `stat` 操作，并提出如果能同时处理多个 `getdents` 请求会更有益。
• [jasonjmcghee] 对项目中图标支持的文件类型选择提出质疑，指出某些常见文件类型（如 `.c`, `.h`）没有图标。
• [adgjlsfhk1] 对 uutils 项目的性能表现感到失望，认为其是推动核心工具现代化的希望，但目前表现不如 GNU。
• [pvtmert] 通过 `strace` 分析 `lsd` 的行为，发现其多次调用 `clock_gettime`，猜测可能与时间计算相关。
• [tln] 提到文件系统性能的改进，指出现代文件系统在处理大量文件时的表现更好，并回忆过去在 ext2 文件系统上的经验。
• [quibono] 对 Zig 语言的内存分配机制提出疑问，关注其在实际应用中的使用方式。
• [Lockal] 提供了一个相关任务的链接，讨论 io_uring 在 uutils 项目中的应用潜力。
• [buybackoff] 提出一个与主题略微偏离的问题，询问 io_uring 在企业级服务器上的具体性能提升数值，特别是针对网络延迟的优化效果。

争议焦点：
• io_uring 是否能有效缓解 NFS 等不可靠网络服务的问题。
• 使用 io_uring 带来的性能提升是否值得在实际应用中替换传统工具。
• `lsr` 工具在文件类型识别和颜色显示方面的不足。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 对 Zig 语言内存分配机制的讨论。
• 对 uutils 项目性能表现的批评和期望。
• 对 io_uring 在企业级环境中的具体性能表现的询问。

data.title: OLEDs of 4 Gbps light the way to faster longer-distance wireless communication
data.author: hhs
data.article_summary: 研究团队通过优化材料选择和设备设计，使有机发光二极管（OLED）实现了高达4 Gbps的数据传输速率，打破了此前记录，并在2米距离内保持这一速度，甚至在10米距离下仍达到2.9 Gbps。关键在于使用了一种名为dinaphthylperylene（DNP）的稳定有机化合物，其具有长寿命和快速发光特性。通过调整OLED的厚度和组成，研究人员在保持亮度的同时提升了速度，实现了更长距离的有效传输。这一突破为OLED在可见光通信（VLC）中的应用开辟了新可能，尤其适用于家庭、办公室以及可穿戴设备的无线通信。未来，随着材料和设计的进一步优化，数据传输速率有望进一步提升。

44614957.article_content:
OLEDs light the way to faster longer-distance wireless communication
Record-breaking 4 Gbps data transmission using organic LEDs demonstrates potential for high-speed, long-distance visible light communication
17 July 2025
Publications
Researchers showed that OLEDs can be made faster by suitable material selection and device design to achieve record-fast transmission. A stable organic compound called dinaphthylperylene (DNP), known for its long operational lifetime and fast light emission, is one key. Top-emitting red OLEDs are pictured: (left) schematic, (right) microscope image. Credit: K. Yoshida et al., doi 10.1117/1.AP.7.3.036005
In the race to develop faster and more flexible wireless communication technologies, researchers are turning to an unexpected source: the same organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) found in smartphone screens and TVs. A recent study from scientists at the University of St Andrews and the University of Cambridge,
published in
Advanced Photonics
, shows that OLEDs can be engineered to transmit data at record-breaking speeds over surprisingly long distances—potentially transforming how we connect devices in the future.
Visible light communication (VLC), sometimes called Li-Fi, uses light instead of radio waves to transmit data. It offers advantages like high bandwidth, low interference, and the ability to integrate with existing lighting systems. OLEDs are especially attractive for VLC because they’re thin, flexible, and easy to manufacture. But until now, they’ve been considered too slow for high-speed data transmission.
This new research challenges that assumption. By carefully selecting materials and optimizing the design of OLEDs, the team achieved data transmission rates of up to 4.0 gigabits per second (Gbps) over a 2-meter distance and 2.9 Gbps over 10 meters—both records for OLED-based systems. For comparison, previous OLED systems topped out at around 2.85 Gbps, and only over very short distances.
The key to this record-breaking advance lies in the use of a stable organic compound called dinaphthylperylene (DNP), known for its long operational lifetime and fast light emission. The team built OLEDs using DNP and fine-tuned the thickness and composition of each layer in the device to balance brightness and speed. They also experimented with different device sizes, finding that larger OLEDs could emit more light without sacrificing speed, which helped maintain strong signals over longer distances.
To test performance, the team set up a VLC system using these OLEDs as transmitters and high-speed photodiodes as receivers. They used a modulation technique called orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM), commonly used in Wi-Fi and 5G, to maximize data throughput. The system was able to maintain low error rates even at high speeds, thanks in part to advanced signal processing and error correction.
Advertisement
An impressive aspect of the study is the 10-meter data link. Achieving nearly 3 Gbps over this distance with a single OLED transmitter is a major leap forward, especially considering that most previous OLED-based systems operated over less than half a meter. This opens the door to practical applications of OLED VLC in homes, offices, and even wearable devices.
The researchers note that enhancing OLED material stability, increasing light output, and refining device architecture could push data rates even higher. As OLED technology continues to evolve in response to display and lighting industries, it will doubtless contribute to the future of wireless communication.
For details, see the original Gold Open Access article by K. Yoshida et al., “
High-speed organic light-emitting diodes based on dinaphthylperylene achieving 4-Gbps communication
,”
Adv. Photon.
7(3), 036005 (2025), doi
10.1117/1.AP.7.3.036005

data.title: Rice could be key to brewing better non-alcoholic beer
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 消费者对低度或无酒精啤酒的需求增加，科学研究正在改善酿造工艺和风味。近期研究建议用碾磨大米替代大麦芽来改善无酒精啤酒的风味，大米能减少麦芽味，增加香草或黄油味，并带来奶油般的口感，且不增加酒精含量。美国在酿酒原料选择上更为灵活，阿肯色州还通过法案鼓励使用当地大米。然而，不同大米品种对酿酒效果不同，需国际合作以获取最佳品种。此外，文化差异影响口味偏好，美国消费者比欧洲消费者更能接受麦芽味较重的啤酒。研究还发现，增加大米比例可加速发酵。

There is increasing consumer demand for low- or non-alcoholic beers, and science is helping improve both the brewing process and the flavor profiles of the final product. One promising approach to better non-alcoholic beer involves substituting barley malt with milled rice, according to two recent papers—
one published
in the International Journal of Food Properties and the
other published
in the Journal of the American Society of Brewing Chemists.
The chemistry of brewing beer is a very active area of research. For instance, earlier this year,
we reported
on Norwegian scientists who
discovered that
sour beers made with the sugars found in peas, beans, and lentils had similar flavor profiles to your average Belgian-style sour beer, yet the brewing process was shorter, with simpler steps. The pea-sugar beers had more lactic acid, ethanol, and flavor compounds than those brewed without them, and they were rated as having fruitier flavors and higher acidity. And sensory panelists detected no trace of undesirable "bean-y" flavors that have limited the use of pea-based ingredients in the past.
But replacing barley malt with rice still might strike some beer aficionados as sacrilege. In Germany, "purity laws" dictate that any beverage classified as a beer—including non-alcoholic beers—must only be made from malted barley, hops, water, and yeast. This produces non-alcoholic beers that have more "worty" flavors (due to higher levels of aldehyde) than might ideally be desired. But not every country is as stringent as Germany. The US is much more flexible when it comes to selecting raw materials, including rice, for brewing beers. In fact, Arkansas
just passed a bill
this spring creating incentives for using rice (grown in Arkansas, of course) in the production of sake and beer.
“Rice isn’t just neutral filler. It’s a tool for innovation,”
said co-author Scott Lafontaine
, a food chemist at the University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture. “It’s time we move beyond outdated perceptions and recognize what rice can offer in creating beer that’s sessionable [under 5 percent alcohol], efficient, and aligned with both tradition and the evolving preferences of today’s consumer.”
Rice, rice, baby
But all rice varietals are not created equal when it comes to brewing beer. Many cultivars currently favored for food applications were chosen for their higher head rice yields and lower glycemic properties; the latter requires rice with higher amylose content and higher gelatinization temperatures—the exact opposite of what's needed for beer. "Without international sourcing and closer collaboration with rice breeders, brewers risk losing access to cultivars best suited for brewing performance,"
said Lafontaine
.
Rice enhances flavor profiles for nonalcoholic beer, reduces fermentation time, and may contribute to flavor stability.
Credit:
Paden Johnson/CC BY-NC-SA
He and his team—including Christian Schubert, a visiting postdoc from the Research Institute for Raw Materials and Beverage Analysis in Berlin—brewed their own non-alcoholic beers, ranging from those made with 100 percent barley malt to ones made with 100 percent rice. They conducted a volatile chemical analysis to identify specific compounds present in the beers and assembled two sensory panels of tasters (one in the US, one in Europe) to assess aromas, flavors, and mouthfeel.
The panelists determined the rice-brewed beers had less worty flavors, and the chemical analysis revealed why: lower levels of aldehyde compounds. Instead, other sensory attributes emerged, most notably vanilla or buttery notes. "If a brewer wanted a more neutral character, they could use nonaromatic rice," the authors wrote. Along with brewing beers with 50 percent barley/50 percent rice, this would produce non-alcoholic beers likely to appeal more broadly to consumers.
The panelists also noted that higher rice content resulted in beers with a fatty/creamy mouthfeel—likely because higher rice content was correlated with increased levels of larger alcohol molecules, which are known to contribute to a pleasant mouthfeel. But it didn't raise the alcohol content above the legal threshold for a nonalcoholic beer.
There were cultural preferences, however. The US panelists didn't mind worty flavors as much as the European tasters did, which might explain why the former chose beers brewed with 70 percent barley/30 percent rice as the optimal mix. Their European counterparts preferred the opposite ratio (30 percent barley/70 percent rice). The explanation "may lie in the sensory expectations shaped by each region's brewing traditions," the authors wrote. Fermentation also occurred more quickly as the rice content increased because of higher levels of glucose and fructose.

不同观点：
• [d00mB0t] 认为当前AI被过度炒作，尤其提到Replit的CEO和市场团队在大力推进AI相关项目。他表达了对目前AI过热现象的担忧。

data.title: 'I was floored by the data': Psilocybin shows anti-aging properties
data.author: Bluestein
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了关于裸盖菇中活性成分裸盖菇素（psilocybin）可能具有抗衰老作用的实验室研究。研究发现，psilocybin能够延长人类细胞的寿命，保护端粒长度，减缓衰老标志，同时减少氧化应激并增加与长寿相关的Sirt1蛋白水平。实验中，老年小鼠在接受psilocybin治疗后，不仅寿命延长，还出现了毛发再生和毛色恢复。然而，研究使用的剂量远高于人类通常使用的剂量，因此其实际应用于人类健康还需更多研究。该研究首次提供了psilocybin潜在抗衰老特性的实验证据。
data.comments_summary: 暂无评论

44615902.article_content:
Psilocybin, the psychoactive ingredient in shrooms, may protect telomeres, structures at the ends of DNA that are known to shrink with aging.
(Image credit: Saska RF via Shutterstock)
Psilocybin, the main psychoactive ingredient in magic mushrooms, extends the lifespan of human cells, a lab study suggests. Researchers also found that the psychedelic compound slows certain hallmarks of aging in older mice while improving their fur quality.
The findings, published July 8 in the journal
npj Aging
, provide the first experimental evidence of psilocybin's potential anti-aging properties.
"The study provides a unique look at the potential of psychedelics to promote healthy aging and provides a provocative mechanism to explain how they do it,"
Scott Thompson
, a professor in the University of Colorado Department of Psychiatry who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email.

New study raises big questions about taurine as anti-aging supplement
College student discovers psychedelic fungus that eluded LSD inventor
However, "much additional work will be required to take these findings forward in a way that will reveal whether or not the findings are applicable and adaptable for human health," Thompson said.
Recently, studies have explored psilocybin's therapeutic potential for treating various conditions, such as
anxiety
,
depression
and neurodegenerative disorders like
Alzheimer's disease
. Some of this research has led to clinical trials
with promising results
. But researchers haven't yet pinned down exactly how the psychedelic achieves its benefits.
One theory, dubbed the "
psilocybin-telomere hypothesis
," proposes that
psilocybin
preserves the length of telomeres, the protective caps of repetitive DNA sequences located at the ends of chromosomes. Researchers have long understood that
telomeres shorten with age
, and the rate of that shortening correlates to the rate of aging.
Related:
'Magic mushroom' compound creates a hyper-connected brain to treat depression
Sign up for the Live Science daily newsletter now
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
Contact me with news and offers from other Future brands

So if psilocybin protects telomere length, could it also delay aging?
To find out, study senior author
Dr. Louise Hecker
, an associate professor at Baylor College of Medicine in Houston, and colleagues administered different doses of
psilocin
, which psilocybin gets broken down into in the body, to isolated human lung and skin cells. The team found that the psilocin extended the lifespans of the cells by up to 57%, depending on the dose given.
The psilocin also preserved the cells' telomere length and reduced levels of
oxidative stress
, or the buildup of reactive molecules. Simultaneously, it led to higher levels of
Sirt1, a protein associated with longevity
.
On the left, the old mice not given psilocybin are shown at two time points in the study. On the right, the images demonstrate how mice given the drug grew back fur where they were once balding, and they also grew brown fur where they were once greying, as indicated by the arrows.
(Image credit: Kato et al. (2025). npj Aging.)
In short, the psilocin made the cells appear like younger cells, Hecker told Live Science. Hecker's research involves looking at the impacts of aging on the body, and everything she knew to test for "just worked" she said. "I was floored by the data."
The team then went on to study the effects of psilocybin on approximately 19-month-old female mice — which, in human years, would be in their early 60s. The mice received monthly doses of psilocybin for 10 months. At the end of that period, 80% of the treated mice were still alive, compared with only 50% of an untreated group. The treated mice also displayed hair growth where they'd previously had bald spots, and their once-white hair grew back brown.
"It's exciting that we can give this intervention in late life and have such a dramatic impact," Hecker said.

• **[sfd17]** 关注变性人在申请美国工作签证时的风险，涉及到性别变更在移民申请中的潜在法律问题。

• **[threway742]** 询问在科研机构工作的签证特例和H-1B签证转换雇主的可能性，涉及到特定行业和职业的签证特权和灵活性。

- **证据准备**：在婚姻移民申请中，共同财务账户、生活安排等被视为重要证据。
- **政策变化**：TN和H-1B签证政策的变动对申请人和雇主的影响。
- **身份转换和维持**：包括从学生签证、TPS等转换到其他身份的法律和实际操作问题。
- **旅行限制**：绿卡持有者和签证申请人在国际旅行中的潜在问题和应对策略。

争议焦点：
- **政策的不确定性**：如TN和H-1B政策的变动带来的不确定性。
- **身份过期后的调整**：如TPS身份转换中的法律风险和实际操作困难。

这些讨论反映了移民过程中的复杂性和多样性，以及申请人在面对法律和政策变化时的实际困扰和需求。

data.author: Topfi

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI代理工具的应用潜力、安全性、错误处理及用户体验

不同观点：
• twalkz：认为AI代理工具能完成90-95%的工作，节省大量时间，但剩下的5-10%错误，尤其是细微错误，可能需要大量时间去修正和处理。这尤其在处理复杂任务和个人数据时会带来麻烦。
• 2oMg3YWV26eKIs：关注安全风险，尤其是代理工具访问个人数据（如邮件和日历）时的隐私泄露风险。特别指出提示注入（prompt injection）可能导致代理执行恶意操作，如泄露私人信息或未经授权进行购买。
• AgentMatrixAI：对AI代理从90%到99%的准确度提升持怀疑态度，认为这是LLM代理的经典"最后一公里问题"。认为许多演示隐藏了真实应用中的问题，过度炒作可能导致对代理工具能力的误解。
• pants2：提到OpenAI的Operator工具在一些网站（如LinkedIn和Amazon）上被封锁，担心代理工具普及后也会面临类似问题，需要通过代理配置等方式解决。
• bredren：讨论了AI代理在保持会话持久性方面的技术挑战，以及如何通过云实例和权限管理等方式解决。认为OpenAI在优化用户体验（UX）方面做得很好，可能吸引非开发者用户。
• ddp26：引用AI 2027团队的预测，认为AI代理在2025年中期会初步亮相，但目前仍难以获得广泛使用。
• alach11：认为当前的AI代理在个人生活中的实用性有限，需要大量的信任和整合工作，Apple和Microsoft在这方面可能更有优势。
• Topfi：赞赏OpenAI在UI设计上的努力，认为其代理工具在视觉呈现和用户信息反馈方面做得很好，比其他实现更具吸引力。
• divan：希望AI代理能提供编辑文档的功能，特别是在项目中连续写作和语音模式的支持。
• dcre：对AI代理访问真实凭证和敏感信息的风险表示担忧。
• dcchambers：以幽默方式指出提示注入的风险，可能被利用来操纵用户行为。
• bryanhogan：一方面认为AI代理非常酷且可能有益，另一方面担心其深层次整合到系统中时可能犯的错误。
• serjester：认为OpenAI转向直接使用用户电脑是一个明智的策略，解决了Operator发布时面临的许多问题，特别是在网络封锁方面。
• jjcm：对LLM开始影响现实世界感到兴奋，认为这是LLM应用的一个重要时刻，并预测未来十年LLM将驱动很大一部分世界经济。
• ck2：以幽默方式指出使用ChatGPT生成大文档并下载可能带来的问题。

补充讨论：
• 安全性和隐私：多个评论提到了AI代理工具在处理个人数据和敏感信息时的安全风险，特别是提示注入和未经授权操作的问题。
• 错误处理：讨论了AI代理工具在处理复杂任务时可能犯的错误，特别是细微错误如何影响其可用性和用户信任。
• 用户体验：对OpenAI在UI设计和用户体验优化方面的努力给予了肯定，认为这可能吸引更多非开发者用户。
• 实用性和整合：讨论了AI代理工具在个人生活和工作中的实用性，以及与其他系统和平台的整合挑战。
• 未来发展：预测了AI代理工具在未来的应用潜力和可能面临的挑战。

data.title: Hungary's oldest library is fighting to save books from a beetle infestation
data.author: smollett
data.article_summary: 匈牙利最古老的潘诺恩哈尔马修道院图书馆正努力拯救约10万本手抄书，这些书受到甲虫侵扰。药店甲虫（也称面包甲虫）不仅出现在食物中，还被书籍的胶水和淀粉吸引。为消灭甲虫，修复人员将书籍放入密封塑料袋，抽空氧气，注入氮气，经过六周处理希望彻底消灭甲虫。处理后，每本书将逐一检查和吸尘，受损书籍将进行后续修复。虽然最古老和珍稀的书未受影响，但任何损坏都被视为对文化和历史遗产的打击。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：图书馆藏书虫害的处理与保护

不同观点：
• bob1029认为控制湿度是简单有效的解决方案，相对湿度（RH）低于50%可以有效阻止生物在干燥环境中繁殖。
• Iryna77指出，整个图书馆藏书因虫害被分类为感染，必须同时进行处理，且由于许多书籍年代久远，最佳处理方法是缺氧处理。然而，Iryna77对 Abbey 希望六周后虫子会被消灭的声明表示担忧，认为这并不乐观。
• maxloh认为，虽然保存原件很重要，但许多风险可以通过将书籍扫描成电子版来减轻，暗示数字化可能是保护书籍内容的一种手段。
• funnym0nk3y对使用温和的灭虫方法感到惊讶，原本期待使用大量的杀虫剂进行处理。

补充讨论：
• mdavid626的问句似乎与主题无关，可能是在寻求特定背景（匈牙利相关）的帮助。
• ChrisArchitect提供了一个讨论链接，可能指向更多相关信息，但链接的具体内容未在此评论中展开。
• EGreg的评论提到了一个与主题无关的链接（关于Pablo的），未提供直接相关的讨论内容。

争议焦点：
• 主要的争议在于处理方法的有效性和对古籍的保护。Iryna77对缺氧处理的效果表示怀疑，而funnym0nk3y则对不使用杀虫剂的温和方法感到意外。

Hungarian library is fighting to save books from beetles
Restoration workers are removing about 100,000 handbound books from their shelves and carefully placing them in crates, the start of a disinfection process that aims to kill the tiny beetles.

1:24 AM ET
By

Books are kept in hermetically sealed plastic sacks for disinfection, at the Pannonhalma Archabbey's library in Pannonhalma, Hungary on July 3.

PANNONHALMA, Hungary — Tens of thousands of centuries-old books are being pulled from the shelves of a medieval abbey in Hungary in an effort to save them from a beetle infestation that could wipe out centuries of history.

NPR staffers pick their favorite fiction reads of 2025 so far
The 1,000-year-old Pannonhalma Archabbey is a sprawling Benedictine monastery that is one of Hungary's oldest centers of learning and a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Restoration workers are removing about 100,000 handbound books from their shelves and carefully placing them in crates, the start of a disinfection process that aims to kill the tiny beetles burrowed into them.
The drugstore beetle, also known as the bread beetle, is often found among dried foodstuffs like grains, flour and spices. But they also are attracted to the gelatin and starch-based adhesives found in books.
Sponsor Message
They have been found in a section of the library housing around a quarter of the abbey's 400,000 volumes.
"This is an advanced insect infestation which has been detected in several parts of the library, so the entire collection is classified as infected and must be treated all at the same time," said Zsófia Edit Hajdu, the chief restorer on the project. "We've never encountered such a degree of infection before."
Abbey houses historical treasures
The beetle invasion was first detected during a routine library cleaning. Employees noticed unusual layers of dust on the shelves and then saw that holes had been burrowed into some of the book spines. Upon opening the volumes, burrow holes could be seen in the paper where the beetles chewed through.
The abbey at Pannonhalma was founded in 996, four years before the establishment of the Kingdom of Hungary. Sitting upon a tall hill in northwestern Hungary, the abbey houses the country's oldest collection of books, as well as many of its earliest and most important written records.
In this photo provided by Pannonhalma Archabbey, a restorer shows an old book with holes in its pages due to a drugstore beetle infestation, at the Pannonhalma Archabbey's library in Pannonhalma, Hungary on July 3.
AP/Pannonhalma Archabbey
hide caption
toggle caption
AP/Pannonhalma Archabbey
For over 1,000 years, the abbey has been among the most prominent religious and cultural sites in Hungary and all of Central Europe, surviving centuries of wars and foreign incursions such as the Ottoman invasion and occupation of Hungary in the 16th century.
Sponsor Message
Ilona Ásványi, director of the Pannonhalma Archabbey library, said she is "humbled" by the historical and cultural treasures the collection holds whenever she enters.
"It is dizzying to think that there was a library here a thousand years ago, and that we are the keepers of the first book catalogue in Hungary," she said.
Performing Arts
Take a peek at Stephen Sondheim's papers, now at the Library of Congress
Among the library's most outstanding works are 19 codices, including a complete Bible from the 13th century. It also houses several hundred manuscripts predating the invention of the printing press in the mid-15th century and tens of thousands of books from the 16th century.
While the oldest and rarest prints and books are stored separately and have not been infected, Ásványi said any damage to the collection represents a blow to cultural, historical and religious heritage.
"When I see a book chewed up by a beetle or infected in any other way, I feel that no matter how many copies are published and how replaceable the book is, a piece of culture has been lost," she said.
Books will spend weeks in an oxygen-free environment
To kill the beetles, the crates of books are being placed into tall, hermetically sealed plastic sacks from which all oxygen is removed. After six weeks in the pure nitrogen environment, the abbey hopes all the beetles will be destroyed.
Before being reshelved, each book will be individually inspected and vacuumed. Any book damaged by the pests will be set aside for later restoration work.

44583316.article_summary: 匈牙利最古老的潘诺恩哈尔马修道院图书馆正努力拯救约10万本手抄书，这些书受到甲虫侵扰。药店甲虫（也称面包甲虫）不仅出现在食物中，还被书籍的胶水和淀粉吸引。为消灭甲虫，修复人员将书籍放入密封塑料袋，抽空氧气，注入氮气，经过六周处理希望彻底消灭甲虫。处理后，每本书将逐一检查和吸尘，受损书籍将进行后续修复。虽然最古老和珍稀的书未受影响，但任何损坏都被视为对文化和历史遗产的打击。

data.title: Ring introducing new feature to allow police to live-stream access to cameras
data.author: xoa
data.article_summary: Ring公司创始人Jamie Siminoff重新掌舵，并恢复了以监控为主、隐私为次的策略，重新引入允许警察直接向用户请求录像的功能，甚至新增允许警察实时访问家庭安全设备的功能。这一举措引发了对公民自由的严重威胁，因为警察曾利用Ring录像监视抗议者，且未经授权获取录像。Ring正在推翻过去几年进行的改革，包括恢复与警察的合作，并计划与Axon合作开发新工具，方便警察获取录像和实时流。此外，Ring计划转向“AI优先”，可能引入视频分析或面部识别技术。员工还被要求展示使用AI的证明以获得晋升。这一系列变化表明Ring正重回大规模监控工具的角色，可能是为了在技术威权主义崛起的背景下谋取利润。公众压力曾迫使Ring改进隐私措施，但现在这些进展正在被逆转。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：隐私、数据保护以及商业和执法机构对个人数据的潜在滥用

不同观点：
• **对“opt-in”机制的不信任**：
  - [zug_zug] 认为“opt-in”常常是默认勾选且隐藏在复杂的菜单中，甚至可能因“bug”而被错误读取。他建议通过SMS和电话号码建立可追溯机制。
  - [josephcsible] 则认为只要严格执行“opt-in”和用户明确同意，隐私问题就不存在。

• **对执法机构滥用权力的担忧**：
  - [haunter] 认为“opt-in”无法阻止执法机构滥用，最终会遭到滥用。
  - [drannex] 强烈反对技术公司与政府合作，认为这会导致滥用和“警察国家”的出现。

• **对商业机构数据收集和隐私保护的监管建议**：
  - [jsrozner] 提出严格监管，禁止未经个人明确许可保留其图像或使用其数据进行商业目的的操作，并建议对违规行为施加高额罚款和奖励举报者。
  - [fma] 认为一些安全系统设计上迫使用户连接云服务，可能为将来数据滥用提供便利。

• **技术实现和替代方案的讨论**：
  - [georgeburdell] 询问是否存在不依赖公司云服务的适中成本系统，并分享自己的私有网络和NAS方案。
  - [thephyber] 表示隐私意识强的用户会避免使用Ring这样的产品。
  - [deadbabe] 询问是否有Ring的开源替代品。

• **对法律和现实情况的讨论**：
  - [ActorNightly] 指出警察需要请求用户数据，而不是直接访问，但承认在联邦层面法律可能不被严格执行。
  - [matt3210] 认为“opt-in”在面对法律传票时毫无意义。

补充讨论：
• **对未来监控社会的担忧**：
  - [booleandilemma] 对未来全时监控的社会表示担忧，认为文明缺乏智慧。

• **对公司管理问题的评论**：
  - [conartist6] 评论了公司内部管理问题和对AI过度依赖对公司发展的影响。

争议焦点：
• **“opt-in”是否能有效保护用户隐私**：一部分人认为只要严格执行用户明确同意，隐私问题可以控制；另一部分人则认为执法机构的滥用和法律漏洞使得“opt-in”形同虚设。
• **技术公司与执法机构合作的正当性**：一些人强烈反对技术公司与政府合作，认为这会导致隐私侵犯和滥用；而另一些人则认为只要用户同意，就不存在滥用问题。

44620002.article_content:
Ring founder Jamie Siminoff is
back at the helm
of the surveillance doorbell company, and with him is the
surveillance-first-privacy-last
approach that made Ring one of the most maligned tech devices. Not only is the company reintroducing new versions of old features which would allow police to request footage directly from Ring users, it is also introducing a new feature that would allow police to request live-stream access to people’s home security devices.
This is a bad, bad step for Ring and the broader public.
Ring is rolling back many of the reforms it’s made in the last few years by easing police access to footage from millions of homes in the United States. This is a grave threat to civil liberties in the United States. After all, police have used Ring footage to
spy
on protestors, and obtained footage
without a warrant or consent of the user
. It is easy to imagine that law enforcement officials will use their renewed access to Ring information to
find people who have had abortions
or track down people for
immigration enforcement
.
Siminoff has announced in a memo seen by
Business Insider
that the company will now be reimagined from the ground up to be “AI first”—whatever that means for a home security camera that lets you see who is ringing your doorbell. We fear that this may signal the introduction of video analytics or
face
recognition
to an already problematic surveillance device.
It was also reported that employees at Ring will have to show
proof that they use AI
in order to get promoted.
Not to be undone with new bad features, they are also planning on rolling back some of the necessary reforms Ring has made: namely
partnering with Axon
to build a new tool that would allow police to request Ring footage directly from users, and also allow users to consent to letting police livestream directly from their device.
After years of serving as the
eyes
and
ears
of police, the company was compelled by public pressure to make a number of necessary changes. They introduced
end-to-end encryption
, they ended their
formal partnerships with police
which were an
ethical minefield
, and they
ended their tool
that facilitated police requests for footage directly to customers. Now they are pivoting back to being a tool of mass surveillance.
Why now? It is hard to believe the company is betraying the trust of its millions of customers in the name of “safety” when violent crime in the United States is reaching
near-historically low levels
. It’s probably not about their customers—the
FTC had to compel
Ring to take its users’ privacy seriously.
No, this is most likely about Ring cashing in on the rising tide of techno-authoritarianism, that is, authoritarianism aided by surveillance tech. Too many tech companies want to profit from our shrinking liberties. Google likewise recently
ended an old ethical commitment
that prohibited it from profiting off of surveillance and warfare. Companies are locking down billion-dollar contracts by selling their products to the defense sector or police.
Shame on Ring.

data.title: Mushroom learns to crawl after being given robot body (2024)
data.author: Anon84
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了康奈尔大学和佛罗伦萨大学的研究团队开发了一种新型生物混合机器人，利用可食用的King Trumpet蘑菇发出的电信号来移动和感知环境。这种机器人通过将真菌菌丝体与电子设备结合，能够感知和响应环境变化，可能应用于农业等领域，如监测土壤化学成分。该研究发表在《Science Robotics》期刊上，标志着生物混合机器人在未来应用中的巨大潜力。此前，类似实验包括将人工虫脑植入乐高机器人以及麻省理工学院研发的结合活体肌肉组织的机器。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：生物混合机器人中使用真菌作为传感器的研究及其潜在影响

不同观点：
• cloudbonsai：认为使用"learn"这个词过于强烈。真菌在此实验中主要是作为紫外线传感器，被动地提供生物信号，而不是主动控制机器人。
• Legend2440：同样持怀疑态度，认为真菌并没有在"学习爬行"，它只是自然地对光产生信号反应，机器人根据信号执行预设的行动。
• ProfHiggs：提到类似现象，如黏菌的复杂行为，暗示对真菌行为的探索具有科学价值。
• lioeters：认为将生物有机体与机器人系统结合具有潜力，并举例说明其他类似实验，如给乌龟装上滑板，或金鱼控制车辆。
• TylerLives：对该技术的发展表示担忧，用反问语气暗示可能的风险。
• amelius和accoil：提供相关参考链接，扩展了关于生物与机器人结合的主题。
• domoregood：用幽默方式表达对真菌控制技术的接受。
• vic_nyc：对该技术表示不安，提出伦理或情感上的质疑。

补充讨论：
• EvanAnderson：提到科幻作品中的类似概念，将讨论引向文学联想。
• mhuffman：提供有关"死灵机器人学"的参考资料，展示其他"有趣"的科学实验，增加了讨论的广度。
• BSOhealth：用幽默方式设想未来真菌可能主导人类技术发展，暗示对技术发展的长远思考。

争议的焦点：
• 真菌是否在实验中表现出"学习"行为，或者仅仅是作为被动传感器存在。
• 对该技术未来发展的潜在风险和伦理问题的不同态度，有人表示担忧和不安，有人则以幽默接受。

Engineers have created a new type of
robot
that places living fungi behind the controls.
The
biohybrid robot
uses electrical signals from an edible type of mushroom called a king trumpet in order to move around and sense its environment.
Developed by an interdisciplinary team from Cornell University in the US and Florence University in Italy, the machine could herald a new era of living robotics.
“Living systems respond to touch, they respond to light, they respond to heat, they respond to even some unknowns, like signals,” said Anand Mishra, a research associate in the Organic Robotics Lab at Cornell.
“That’s why we think, OK, if you wanted to build future
robots
, how can they work in an unexpected environment? We can leverage these living systems, and any unknown input comes in, the robot will respond to that.”
Researchers from Cornell University in the US and the University of Florence in Italy placed a species of edible mushroom within a robot body
(
Robert Shepherd
)
Different inputs, such as ultraviolet light, resulted in different outcomes for the way the robot moved. A video of one of the mushroom-controlled robots shows it moving slowly across a surface by pumping its robotic legs. Another biohybrid robot uses a wheeled system in order to move around.
Combining this mobility with the fungi’s ability to sense chemical and biological signals could prove useful in a range of applications, according to the researchers.
“By growing mycelium into the electronics of a robot, we were able to allow the biohybrid machine to sense and respond to the environment,” said Rob Shepherd, a professor of mechanical and aerospace engineering at Cornell.
“The potential for future robots could be to sense soil chemistry in row crops and decide when to add more fertiliser, for example, perhaps mitigating downstream effects of agriculture like harmful algal blooms.”
Details of the biohybrid robot were published in the journal
Science Robotics
, in
a study
titled ‘Sensorimotor control of robots mediated by electro-physiological measurements of fungal mycelia’.
It is not the first time a living organism has been placed inside a robot body, though the use of mushrooms could offer a major breakthrough in the field of biohybrid robotics due to their ability to grow and survive in harsh conditions.
Previous experiments have included
an artificial worm brain placed inside a Lego robot
, which was able to recreate the creature’s movements and intentions.
Earlier this year, researchers from Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) created a machine that was integrated with living muscle tissue in order to sense and adapt to its environment.

44591775.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了康奈尔大学和佛罗伦萨大学的研究团队开发了一种新型生物混合机器人，利用可食用的King Trumpet蘑菇发出的电信号来移动和感知环境。这种机器人通过将真菌菌丝体与电子设备结合，能够感知和响应环境变化，可能应用于农业等领域，如监测土壤化学成分。该研究发表在《Science Robotics》期刊上，标志着生物混合机器人在未来应用中的巨大潜力。此前，类似实验包括将人工虫脑植入乐高机器人以及麻省理工学院研发的结合活体肌肉组织的机器。

主要讨论点：生物混合机器人中使用真菌作为传感器的研究及其潜在影响

不同观点：

• lioeters：认为将生物有机体与机器人系统结合具有潜力，并举例说明其他类似实验，如给乌龟装上滑板，或金鱼控制车辆。
• TylerLives：对该技术的发展表示担忧，用反问语气暗示可能的风险。

• domoregood：用幽默方式表达对真菌控制技术的接受。

补充讨论：

data.title: Intel to boost gross margins – new products must deliver 50% gross profit
data.author: walterbell
data.article_summary: Intel宣布将不再批准毛利率低于50%的新项目，以重振其利润率。CEO Lip-Bu Tan正推动公司毛利率重回50%以上，取消或调整不盈利项目，并可能进行多达20%的裁员。尽管公司整体尚未达到该目标，但未来项目如Panther Lake和Nova Lake预计将实现这一利润率。此举旨在提高盈利能力，但也引发内部对产品竞争力与成本结构的争论。Tan还计划通过裁减中层管理层和投资顶尖人才来重塑公司文化。这一策略获得投资者支持，但执行中面临挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Intel的战略调整及其影响

不同观点：
• 一些评论者对Intel专注于高利润项目表示怀疑，认为这种策略可能导致创新能力下降。例如，[0cf8612b2e1e]提到这种策略可能意味着所有实验性的研发都将被排除，只有渐进式的进步才能带来利润。[Arnt]和[tracerbulletx]通过讽刺的方式表达了类似的担忧，指出高层可能过于乐观，而现实往往不如预期。

• 部分评论关注Intel领导层变动及其影响。[bilbyx]对Intel董事会过早让Pat Gelsinger离职表示不解，并质疑Lip-Bu Tan是否是更好的选择。此外，[tchbnl]对Intel在现任领导下的未来表示悲观，甚至猜测可能会有公司收购Intel。

• 一些评论者讨论了Intel的利润策略是否意味着市场重心的转移。[ThrowawayR2]提出Intel是否会因此减少对消费级PC市场的关注，转而更多地投向服务器和企业产品。[ksec]则指出Intel在服务器市场面临AMD的激烈竞争，并认为AMD需要在各个市场进一步增加市场份额。

• 其他评论关注Intel的行业地位和历史变化。[Animats]引用了Intel CEO的话，指出Intel已经不再是十大半导体公司之一，尽管其他来源将其列为第五。[bilbyx]将Intel的现状与波音公司进行比较，认为两者都过于关注股东价值而忽视了其他重要方面。

• 还有评论讨论了Intel的人才策略。[light_hue_1]质疑Intel是否会通过提高薪酬和改善待遇来吸引和保留顶尖人才，特别是在与FAANG公司竞争的背景下。[wolpoli]则认为Intel出售其ARM CPU产品线的决策是这种短视思维的产物。

补充讨论：
• 部分评论者对新闻报道的实际内容和价值提出质疑。[roenxi]认为文章并没有提供实质性的新信息，只是重申了Intel CEO希望公司盈利并优先考虑高利润产品的常见策略。

• 一些评论通过对比其他公司的历史案例来分析Intel的现状。[cjbgkagh]将Intel的策略与Marissa Mayer在雅虎时期的做法相比较，认为这可能反映出公司在面临竞争压力时的无奈选择。

争议焦点：
• Intel新策略是否会导致创新能力的下降以及市场竞争力的削弱是主要争议点。部分评论者担心过度关注利润和高利润项目可能损害公司的长远发展，而其他评论者则认为这种调整是必要的以应对当前的市场环境。

44620774.article_content:
(Image credit: Intel)
Intel will not be entertaining any projects that do not promise to double its money going forward. Michelle Johnston Holthaus, CEO of Intel Products, announced at Bank of America's
global technology conference
that Intel is no longer approving new projects that cannot be proven to earn at least 50% gross margin "based on a set of industry expectations."
Holthaus explained Intel's new risk-averse policy as "something that we probably should have had before, but we have it now so that product doesn’t move forward; you actually don’t get engineers assigned to it if it’s not 50% or higher gross margins moving forward."
Holthaus also clarified that while Intel is not expecting or projecting 50% gross margins across all operations, it is a number the company is aspiring toward internally. All of Intel's future roadmap operations, including
Panther Lake
and
Nova Lake
, are also currently expected to reach the 50% gross profit number that the rest of the business aspires to.
You may like
Intel is not a top 10 chipmaker anymore, according to new CEO Lip-Bu Tan
Intel might axe the 18A process node for foundry customers, essentially leaving TSMC with no rival
Intel posts flat year-over-year earnings and bleak outlook, warns about macroeconomic pressures
The drive behind this initiative is reportedly coming from Intel's
new CEO
, Lip-Bu Tan. Tan is reportedly "laser focused on the fact that we need to get our gross margins back up above 50%." To accomplish this, Tan is also said to be investigating and potentially cancelling or changing unprofitable deals with other companies.
Intel's margins have slipped to new lows for the company in recent months.
MacroTrends
reports Intel's trailing 12 months gross margin for Q1 2025 was as low as 31.67%. Intel's gross margins had hovered around the 60% mark for the ten years leading up to the COVID-19 pandemic, falling beneath 50% in Q2 2022 and continuing to steadily fall ever since.
Holthaus predicts a "tug-of-war" to ensue within Intel in the coming months as engineers and executives reckon with being forced between a rock and a hard place. "We need to be building products that... fit the right competitive landscape and requirements of our customers, but also have the right cost structure in place. It really requires us to do both."
CEO Lip-Bu Tan has done much to streamline Intel's operation and right a rocking ship inherited from previous Intel chief Pat Gelsinger. Another
major round of layoffs
, potentially up to 20% of the remaining workforce, is coming in Q2, arriving after a major leadership change-up to remove middle management between Tan and other team leads.

Tan is also quoted as wanting to turn Intel into an "engineering-focused company" again under his leadership. To reach this, Tan has committed to investing in recruiting and retaining top talent; "I believe Intel has lost some of this talent over the years; I want to create a culture of innovation empowerment." Maintaining a culture of empowering innovation and top talent seems, on its face, at odds with layoffs and a lock on projects not projected to gross 50% margins, but Tan seemingly has Intel investors on his side in these pursuits.

data.title: Ask HN: What would convince you to take AI seriously?
data.author: atleastoptimal
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI的能力及其对社会的影响

不同观点：
• **exabrial**：认为AI不应该假装知道所有答案，避免像Reddit上的“专家”争论一样，过度自信地回答问题。应该坦诚自己的局限性。

• **al_borland**：AI不仅需要解决已知问题，还需要有能力创造未来。如果AI自动化所有人类劳动，社会结构需要大幅调整，否则会导致混乱。目前过度宣传AI取代人类是不负责任的。

• **andy99**：解决基准问题不代表真正的智能，AI需要展示真正的智能行为，而不仅仅是解决人为设定的有限问题。此外，当前的LLM（大语言模型）架构可能不足以支持真正的智能。

• **saadn92**：有些人不愿意适应AI的发展，但随着AI的广泛应用，他们将被迫适应。即使个人不喜欢AI，但它确实有其用途，现在不学习将来也得适应。

• **alganet**：认为讨论AI是否需要被重视是愚蠢的问题，没必要为此下结论。

• **mcphage**：对于开发工作，像DHH的“15分钟内建一个博客”演示那样的任务是可以的。对于原创性工作，AI应该解决一些知名的未解难题，例如Collatz猜想。

• **bigyabai**：AI如果能够替代真正的思维工作，其结果应该是显而易见的，特别是通过显著降低劳动成本体现出来。

• **noncoml**：不相信AI目前可以取代思维工作，认为AI目前只是一个辅助工具。真正的AI取代人类思维的时刻还未到来，大家到时自然会知道。

• **neximo64**：质疑为什么要认真对待AI，并反问为什么要提出这个问题。

补充讨论：
- AI是否能够创造未来和解决未知问题是讨论的焦点之一。
- AI对社会结构和劳动市场的潜在影响引发了一些人的担忧，尤其是自动化可能导致的混乱和痛苦。
- 对AI当前能力的评价存在分歧，有人认为它只是解决有限问题的工具，而有人则期待它展示真正的智能。
- 讨论中也存在对AI过度宣传的批评和对AI适应性的不同态度。

data.title: YouTube Won the Battle for TV Viewers
data.author: JumpCrisscross
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：YouTube作为主要视频平台的地位及其替代方案的困境

不同观点：
• JKCalhoun认为YouTube已经形成了一种事实上的垄断，因为内容创作者聚集在YouTube上，以获取流量和广告收入。这种循环使得其他替代平台难以打破YouTube的主导地位，类似于eBay的情况。
• ksec指出，传统电视广播的内容在流媒体服务中没有得到很好的整合，本应由Apple或Google来推动这种整合，但由于各自的商业利益，他们并没有这样做。ksec还批评了Apple和Google在产品创新上的缺失，认为他们在Steve Jobs去世后缺乏对客户需求的关注，产品多由营销和销售驱动。
• heavensteeth表达了对传统电视和广播中广告过多的不满，认为这是他们转向其他平台的原因，但也指出某些平台上内容和广告的比例不合理。
• al_borland提到其大多数YouTube观看行为是通过AppleTV进行的，暗示了跨平台体验的重要性。
• consumer451指出YouTube在音乐流媒体领域也处于领先地位，这一现象出乎其意料，进一步强调了YouTube的多功能性和广泛影响力。

补充讨论：
• YouTube垄断地位的成因及其对内容创作者和观众的影响。
• 传统电视内容在流媒体平台上的整合不足及其原因。
• Apple和Google在产品开发和用户体验上的商业策略和不足。
• 广告对观众选择平台的影响以及不同平台上的广告比例问题。
• YouTube在音乐流媒体领域的意外主导地位及其影响。

争议焦点：
• YouTube是否真正形成了垄断，以及这种垄断是否对内容创作者和用户不利。
• Apple和Google在流媒体服务上的策略是否忽略了用户需求，偏向商业利益。

• ksec指出，传统电视广播的内容在流媒体服务中没有得到很好的整合，本应由Apple或Google来推动这种整合，但由于各自的商业利益，他们并没有这样做。ksec还批评了Apple和Google在产品创新上的缺失，认为他们在Steve Jobs去世后缺乏对客户需求的关注，产品多由营销和销售驱动。
• heavensteeth表达了对传统电视和广播中广告过多的不满，认为这是他们转向其他平台的原因，但也指出某些平台上内容和广告的比例不合理。
• al_borland提到其大多数YouTube观看行为是通过AppleTV进行的，暗示了跨平台体验的重要性。
• consumer451指出YouTube在音乐流媒体领域也处于领先地位，这一现象出乎其意料，进一步强调了YouTube的多功能性和广泛影响力。

补充讨论：
• YouTube垄断地位的成因及其对内容创作者和观众的影响。
• 传统电视内容在流媒体平台上的整合不足及其原因。
• Apple和Google在产品开发和用户体验上的商业策略和不足。
• 广告对观众选择平台的影响以及不同平台上的广告比例问题。
• YouTube在音乐流媒体领域的意外主导地位及其影响。

争议焦点：
• YouTube是否真正形成了垄断，以及这种垄断是否对内容创作者和用户不利。
• Apple和Google在流媒体服务上的策略是否忽略了用户需求，偏向商业利益。

data.article_summary: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的多代理方法，以增强对COBOL代码的解释。COBOL因其复杂性和老旧，加上开发者减少，维护变得困难，尤其是缺乏文档。该方法使用两个LLM代理协作生成代码功能、文件及项目的解释，并结合上下文信息提升解释准确性。实验评估显示，该方法在函数和文件级别的解释上显著优于基准方法，尤其在处理超出LLM token限制的长代码时表现突出，并在项目级别成功解释了82%的项目功能和目的。

View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Common Business Oriented Language (COBOL) is a programming language used to develop business applications that are widely adopted by financial, business, and government agencies. Due to its age, complexity, and declining number of COBOL developers, maintaining COBOL codebases is becoming increasingly challenging. In particular, the lack of documentation makes it difficult for new developers to effectively understand and maintain COBOL systems. Existing research utilizes large language models (LLMs) to explain the functionality of code snippets. However, COBOL presents unique challenges due to its architectural and syntactical differences, which often cause its code to exceed the token window size of LLMs. In this work, we propose a multi-agent approach that leverages two LLM-based agents working collaboratively to generate explanations for functions, files, and the overall project. These agents incorporate together by utilizing contextual information from the codebase into the code explanation prompts. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach using 14 open-source, real-world COBOL projects. Our results indicate that our approach performs significantly better than the baseline in function code explanation, with improvements of 12.67%, 18.59%, and 0.62% in terms of METEOR, chrF, and SentenceBERT scores, respectively. At the file level, our approach effectively explains both short and long COBOL files that exceed the token window size of LLMs and surpass the baseline by 4.21%, 10.72%, and 14.68% in explaining the purpose, functionality, and clarity of the generated explanation. At the project level, our approach generates explanations that convey the functionality and purpose of 82% of the selected projects.

data.title: Meta says it won't sign Europe AI agreement
data.author: rntn
data.article_summary: Meta Platforms拒绝签署欧盟的人工智能行为准则，认为该准则过度监管，将阻碍公司发展。全球事务主管Joel Kaplan表示，该准则引入了诸多法律不确定性，超出了欧盟《人工智能法》的范围。该法旨在提升技术透明度和安全性，但Kaplan批评欧洲在AI监管上走错方向。此前，欧洲委员会发布了最终版准则，由企业自行决定是否签署。ASML Holding和Airbus等公司也曾反对该准则，呼吁推迟两年实施，而OpenAI则已承诺签署。Kaplan今年取代Nick Clegg担任现职。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧盟人工智能法案（AI Act）及其自愿行为守则的实施和影响

不同观点：
• **反对推迟实施的观点**：一些评论（如[jahewson], [isodev]）认为，尽管法规可能繁琐，但它们对于保护版权和规范AI使用是必要的。尤其是[isodev]提到，作为公民，支持AI法案，因为需要对技术巨头施加限制以保护人类利益。

• **支持推迟实施的观点**：[ankit219], [cakealert]等人认为，法案和行为守则的实施不够明确，可能导致过度的监管负担，尤其是对开源模型的责任要求过于严格。他们指出，40家欧盟公司要求推迟两年实施，因为需要更多时间来适应法规。[cakealert]还提到，AI发展的势头无法阻挡，法规可能无法有效干预。

• **对Meta立场的批评和质疑**：[rchaud], [mediumsmart]等评论质疑Meta反对法案的动机，认为Meta只是为了保护其自身增长，而不是出于对法规合理性的关切。他们指出，Meta的反对缺乏具体说明什么是令人反感的政策。

• **对法规具体影响的担忧**：[throwpoaster], [chvid]等担心法规会导致不必要的繁文缛节，比如在所有LLM中添加弹出提示，类似于网站上的cookies弹窗。此外，[chvid]质疑Meta为何需要签署自愿协议，既然欧盟法律已经要求在其境内运营的公司遵守。

• **对Meta和欧盟公司利益的讨论**：[sorokod], [paulddraper]提到Meta关注欧洲公司的增长问题，担心法案会限制前沿AI模型的发展。同时，[paulddraper]指出OpenAI已经承诺签署自愿行为守则，显示不同公司对法规的不同态度。

补充讨论：
• **对法规制定透明度的关注**：[vanderZwan]承认自己对AI协议的偏见，因为不了解具体内容而难以判断其实际影响。
• **对法规措辞的建议**：[chrisweekly]指出新闻中对Meta立场的描述存在措辞歧义，建议使用连字符以避免误解。

争议焦点：法案的实施是否过于繁琐和严格，是否会阻碍AI技术的创新与发展，以及Meta反对法案的真实动机。

data.title: Asynchrony is not concurrency
data.author: kristoff_it
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了异步（asynchrony）、并发（concurrency）和并行（parallelism）之间的区别，强调了异步并不等同于并发。作者指出，异步是指任务可以不按顺序执行但仍保持正确性，而并发是指系统能够同时推进多个任务。在Zig语言中，异步并不意味着并发，因为使用`io.async`并不强制要求并发执行，可以在单线程阻塞模式下运行。这种区分有助于更精确地描述代码行为，并解决编程生态中因概念混淆导致的问题，如库作者的重复工作、用户必须放弃同步代码等。明确异步与并发的区别能改善编程体验，避免不必要的复杂性和潜在的死锁问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于async和并发（concurrency）的定义和实际应用的讨论

不同观点：
• Yoric认为，async意味着代码为并发结构化，但async代码中仍然可能出现用户导致的竞态条件（race conditions）。他指出，async并不自动等同于正确性，并发问题依然存在。
• jayd16认为，将"让出执行权"（yielding execution）从并发的定义中分离出来并创造新的"异步"（asynchrony）术语会增加困惑。他认为并发本质上包含了让出执行权的概念。
• kazinator指出，异步是一种抽象，它将请求的提交和结果的收集分离开来，允许但不强制并发实现。他强调，异步的动机在于获得并发带来的好处，某些异步抽象无法在单线程中实现。
• reichstein认为，异步在单线程、合作式多任务（cooperative multitasking）环境下有意义，而在多线程或并发执行模型中则不需要异步，因为可以使用阻塞I/O。
• kobzol担心Zig的新I/O设计在库的编写中可能导致错误，因为库作者无法确定I/O是单线程还是多线程，是否使用事件I/O。他们认为在广泛的I/O实现中编写并发/异步代码将非常困难，需要防御性编程。
• t43562指出，异步代码的测试难度大，难以确保所有可能的生产场景都已覆盖。他们还提到，多线程程序更难写和调试，需要小心处理。

补充讨论：
• threatofrain认为，作者在并发的定义上混淆了概念，并引用了一篇论文来支持其观点。
• jlouis提出，通过测试异步术语在多种语言和并发设计中的有用性来判断其必要性。
• dvt认为，"异步"是一个糟糕的词汇，建议使用更精确的数学术语"交换性"（commutativity）。他们认为现有的异步编程范式令人困惑，不如使用已经熟悉的模式。
• northhnbesthn批评文章过于复杂，认为工具和实现有问题。
• nemothekid对Zig中无栈协程的实现方式感到困惑，并担心FFI可能导致阻塞系统调用。
• tossandthrow指出，文章没有提及并发中的一些陷阱，如执行非幂等函数多次时需要互斥锁。
• danaugrs对Zig即将推出的异步I/O表示期待。
• butterisgood通过日常生活中的例子解释了异步和并发的区别，并指出它们不同于并行。
• skybrian认为，库在不同环境中的可移植性是重要的，类型系统可以帮助捕获函数调用中的错误。

争议焦点：
